$comment: The front ends' recorded expectation of the back end's API. The generated
client is not committed, so this file is what `php artisan api-client:check`
compares a fresh generation against. Every field is a duplicate of something
the back end also knows; that is the point, because a check cannot detect a
change it has no independent record of.
route   the Laravel route name the function is generated from
method  the HTTP verb the function must answer
path    the URL the function must produce, including the /api prefix
name    the operation name in packages/api-client/src/operations.ts
